definition.name: Pairing phase B - authenticated media registration

nodes.label: R3 authenticated UDP endpoint
nodes.task_summary: Implement authenticated UDP registration with real socket proof
nodes.prompt: TASK: Implement R3 current-session authenticated UDP registration on host and all native clients. DELIVERABLE: minimal tested implementation and .omo/pairing-20260910/reports/b-udp.md. SCOPE: clients/rust/erd-proto/src/handshake.rs, erd-app/src/session.rs, erd-app/src/bin/erd_client.rs, erd-host/src/session.rs; erd-net/src/udp_gcm.rs only if existing API is insufficient; corresponding protocol/app/host/net test fixtures. No identity/discovery/UI/lifecycle implementation or capture/encode refactor. REQUIREMENTS: mandatory authenticated-registration capability bit 7 on both handshake sides; preserve v3 codec, fail before Ready/media on missing support. Reuse sealed empty Ping, validate authenticated header/payload, preserve cipher nonce ownership, and fix endpoint after first valid registration. Reject plaintext, wrong-key, tampered, prior-session, non-registration and post-registration hijack attempts without changing endpoint. Remember the real CLI has its own explicit capability mask, independent of SessionConfig::direct. VERIFY: genuine RED before fix and GREEN on real UDP sockets after invalid packets demonstrably consumed, with controlled frame to valid socket; real client/host capability-mismatch tests; cargo test --manifest-path clients/rust/Cargo.toml -p erd-host -p erd-app udp plus affected proto/net and new named tests. Update only modern fixtures to advertise capability; keep intentional legacy rejection cases. Prepare actual erd-client and existing QA wrapper builds on Omarchy for coordinator live rerun. STOP WHEN all R3 code and socket/capability regressions pass once with receipts, scoped builds pass, and b-udp.md exists. Work only in /Volumes/T9-Mac/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite. All implementation/follow-up fixes must use this Gemini 3.8 Flash invocation; never change model settings. Read docs/remote-connection-pairing-review-plan-20260910.md, .omo/pairing-20260910/contracts.md (opening lead amendments take precedence), and .omo/pairing-20260910/phase-b-handoff.md. Preserve existing unrelated dirty discovery/UI/input changes, and the uncommitted A-stage client authentication helper/tests awaiting integration in C. Use apply_patch for every source edit. No commits, publishing, permanent deployment, production-host restarts, or emulators. All Rust check/test/build ONLY on indo@100.91.254.71 in /home/indo/projects/erd-pairing-20260910, with PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/home/indo/erd-ffmpeg7/lib/pkgconfig and LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/indo/erd-ffmpeg7/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Sync only assigned changed files, with relative paths. Start long commands via tool.monitor from eval, never sleep/poll. Before each new RED action pin exact test name and invocation in the append-only notepad /var/folders/zh/7cc25lt91b1_dj577306nwdh0000gn/T/ulw-20260910-111421.XXXXXX.md.pNqwGP19PH. Existing original live RED is already captured; do not fake a RED by changing a test assertion. Reports must contain actual commands, selected-test counts, raw output paths, exit codes, and owned resource cleanup. Final personal review belongs to the coordinator.
